marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 15 knots this morning and to
northwest 20 Thursday morning. Wind diminishing to light Thursday
evening. Scattered showers changing to scattered flurries Thursday
morning. Fog patches dissipating near noon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 near noon Thursday then
subsiding to 1 Thursday evening.<br/>

marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots increasing to northwest 20 this
afternoon then diminishing to northwest 15 near midnight. Wind increasing to

afternoon. <br/>
